title: Know who is deciding what
when: Authoring a release approval or receiving its request
need: Release human-approval is distinct from a QA verdict. Review exact run/stage, declared reviewers and any/all policy. One approval may still leave others outstanding; cleared approval wakes the same run driver.
surface: approve skill lines 17–58; deployment-runs approve help.
gap: Concept exists and execution has a home; the delivery setup journey should offer this choice when defining release risk rather than leave users to discover stage JSON.
